scope: One stock LOITER/Stop comparison; unchanged stock executable, no custom controller/planner or native-mode integration.
prediction: Under same bounded forward RC input, clear scene advances while blocked scene slows and holds before the box. Stop is a bounded blocked outcome, not a detour or route completion.
manual_sequence: Fresh scene/profile; verify disarmed sensor/rangefinder/proximity health.
Normal GUIDED arm/takeoff3m; observe healthy hover.
Neutral RC/throttle1500, switch LOITER, verify mode/altitude.
Apply same forward pitch RC1400; clear case neutralize near5m progress; blocked case observe stop while input held, maximum20s.
Neutral RC, hold, LAND, automatic disarm/on-ground; stop only owned sessions.
rollback: Fresh default L12 scene/profile, no observation adapter; verify RNGFND1_TYPE0 and prior avoidance values, disarmed/on-ground. Stop all owned processes.
limitations: No-return never establishes clearance; known single primitive wall/corridor is evaluation context.
No full obstacle/body collision qualification; DART mesh issue remains.
No stock avoidance loss-of-sensor fail-safe qualification, global route feasibility, detour, reliability or hardware.
